faqData.a: Sebagai lulusan Teknik Informatika dari Universitas Muhammadiyah Jember dengan fokus pada Data Analyst dan Full-stack Developer, saya berspesialisasi dalam analisis data, pengelolaan database, dan pengembangan aplikasi web yang efisien.

faqData.q: Apakah Anda tersedia untuk kolaborasi riset atau freelance?
faqData.a: Tentu saja. Saya selalu terbuka untuk proyek freelance inovatif, pekerjaan purna waktu, atau kolaborasi teknis yang mengutamakan pemecahan masalah dengan data dan pengembangan aplikasi web.

faqData.q: Apa tech stack tipikal Anda untuk produksi?
faqData.a: Untuk analisis data, saya menggunakan Python, SQL, Pandas, Tableau, dan Power BI. Untuk pengembangan aplikasi web, saya biasanya menggunakan React, Node.js, Tailwind CSS, dan Next.js.

faqData.q: Apakah Anda memiliki pengalaman dengan proyek enterprise atau lab?
faqData.a: Ya, saya telah mengerjakan berbagai proyek seperti sistem pencatatan keuangan harian, analisis tren teknologi menggunakan dataset skala besar, hingga pembuatan website company profile untuk UKM.

faqData.q: Bagaimana cara memulai kemitraan atau proyek?
faqData.a: Cara paling efisien adalah menggunakan formulir kontak di atas atau menghubungi langsung melalui email di sulistyowatimunawaroh@gmail.com. Saya akan dengan senang hati merespons untuk mendiskusikan kebutuhan sistem atau analisis data Anda.

proj-1.title: Infly Network
proj-1.description: A comprehensive customer management and multi-month billing application designed specifically for WiFi service providers.
proj-1.longDescription: Developed a full-stack customer management system tailored for Infly Networks to streamline their WiFi service operations. The application facilitates efficient subscriber data management, network service tracking, and multi-month billing cycles. Built with Next.js, Tailwind CSS, and Supabase, the platform provides administrators with a secure, fast, and responsive dashboard to manage daily business operations and customer relationships seamlessly.

proj-2.title: Probolinggo Web Portal
proj-2.description: Integrated digital information portal to promote tourism and regional potential of Probolinggo.
proj-2.longDescription: Built a responsive website platform presenting the latest information, tourist destinations, and local SMEs in Probolinggo. Integrated modern design and a content management system to facilitate regular regional information updates.

proj-3.title: DataCo Supply Chain Analysis
proj-3.description: An end-to-end data analytics and storytelling project identifying logistical inefficiencies and revenue risks for C-Level executives.
proj-3.longDescription: Conducted a comprehensive C-Level data storytelling and performance audit based on the DataCo Supply Chain dashboard. Analyzed global operational data (2015-2017) to identify the root causes behind a low net profit margin (10.8%) despite a high gross revenue of $36.7M. The analysis uncovered major logistical bottlenecks causing $20.1M in late delivery costs, destructive discount strategies, and over $827K in potential fraud risks detected via AI predictive modeling.

proj-4.title: GoLib - Interactive Digital Library
proj-4.description: Part of the Goghotech ecosystem, GoLib is an interactive digital library web application designed to make reading PDF book collections easy and comfortable.
proj-4.longDescription:
GoLib is a digital library platform developed as part of the Goghotech ecosystem. The inspiration for creating this website stems from my personal hobby of reading books, but being constrained by a lack of funds to purchase them directly. Therefore, this platform was built to organize and arrange PDF books to resemble a real library layout, making it easy for users to browse and read books for free.

The website features an interactive flipbook-style reading interface, complete with dark and light theme options to provide an optimal reading experience.

Disclaimer: The GoLib platform is intended purely as an educational medium[cite: 1]. I strongly encourage all readers to continue appreciating and supporting the authors' works by reading or purchasing books legally through official websites, bookstores, or authorized provider applications[cite: 1].

proj-5.title: GoNotes - Productivity & Habit Tracker
proj-5.description: A web-based productivity application equipped with a habit tracker, to-do list, Pomodoro timer, daily journal, and analytics dashboard.
proj-5.longDescription: Stemming from a personal struggle to manage a disorganized daily schedule, GoNotes was developed into a comprehensive productivity application. It features custom habit tracking, a Pomodoro-integrated to-do list, daily journaling, and analytical dashboards spanning daily to yearly scales. Built with Next.js, Firebase (Authentication & Database), and Tailwind CSS, the application supports Dark/Light mode, is fully responsive, and can be installed as a PWA across various devices.

proj-6.title: UD Cahaya Makmur Company Profile
proj-6.description: Company profile and catalog website for UD Cahaya Makmur.
proj-6.longDescription: A company profile website for branding purposes and making it easier for potential customers to view the sales catalog of UD Cahaya Makmur.

proj-7.title: Momentum Candle Trading Bot
proj-7.description: Automated trading bot implementing the Momentum Candle strategy.
proj-7.longDescription: Developed an automated trading bot using MQL5 that executes strategies in the XAUUSD Forex market.

proj-8.title: AdventureWorks Enterprise Analytics
proj-8.description: Full-stack enterprise analytics dashboard combining Sales, Logistics, and PPIC data using FastAPI and React.
proj-8.longDescription: Developed an Enterprise Control Tower providing comprehensive analytics for Sales, Logistics, PPIC, Finance, HR, Territory, and Sentiment. The backend is powered by Python (FastAPI) to process complex data and deliver insights via RESTful APIs, which are then consumed and interactively visualized through a modern React dashboard using Recharts.

proj-9.title: GoGames - Educational and Entertaining Game
proj-9.description: Educational game application to train speed and accuracy in basic arithmetic.
proj-9.longDescription: Built an interactive web-based platform to test users fast counting skills with various difficulty levels, precision timing calculations, and a dynamic on-screen scoring system.

proj-10.title: GoFin - Financial Tracking System
proj-10.description: Web application for tracking daily financial expenses for singles and couples.
proj-10.longDescription: Built a full-stack application to track inventory items in real-time with notification features and a comprehensive dashboard.

proj-11.title: Analyzing Emerging Skill Requirements and Technology Trends
proj-11.description: Interactive dashboard using Python and SQLite to analyze global developer ecosystem trends.
proj-11.longDescription:
Analyzed the global developer ecosystem using Stack Overflow Survey data, BeautifulSoup web-scraping data, and API simulations to identify future technology trend shifts.
Detailed technical competencies and workflows learned:
• Data Collection & Wrangling (SQL & Python): Merged survey CSV data with external scraped salary data, handled missing values (Mode/Median), removed duplicates, and filtered outliers using the Interquartile Range (IQR) method.
• Exploratory Data Analysis (Python): Performed string manipulation and data aggregation using Pandas and NumPy to map programming language trends, databases, cloud infrastructure, and demographics in depth.
• Data Visualization & Dashboarding (Plotly, Seaborn, & WordCloud): Built interactive stakeholder dashboards with multi-panel visualizations such as Bubble Charts, Word Clouds, Treemaps, and dynamic geographic mapping to generate actionable business insights.

proj-12.title: Gotest - Job Preparation Test
proj-12.description: Web-based Kraepelin/Pauli psychological test simulation for recruitment practice.
proj-12.longDescription: Digitized the number concentration test (newspaper test) into a dynamic web application. The system can calculate speed metrics, accuracy rates, and generate a user work endurance graph instantly once the test session ends.

proj-13.title: Tutoring Attendance System
proj-13.description: Integrated digital attendance management system for tutoring centers.
proj-13.longDescription: Web-based application for tracking student attendance in real-time. This system is equipped with automatic monthly recapitulation features and an analytical reporting dashboard to facilitate monitoring by tutors.

proj-14.title: Superstore Sales Analysis & Customer Segmentation Engine
proj-14.description: Machine Learning model to optimize marketing strategies using Python (RFM) & React Dashboard.
proj-14.longDescription: Developed a Full-Stack analysis system using Python (Pandas) for automated data processing and RFM Segmentation algorithms, subsequently visualized through an interactive React JS dashboard.

proj-15.description: Snakes and ladders game designed for couples to have deep talks.
